text:
Maya: @here Quick holiday fun — we're doing a Redwood 2026 'Pets of Redwood' wall calendar and need entries!
Maya: Drop a photo of your pet (or a local foster pet) in this thread by Friday EOD. We'll pick 12 winners + a cover and do a tiny raffle for treats :tada:
Maya: Please name files like `petname_owner.jpg` and include a one-line caption (max 15 words).
Maya: Example submission format:
```
file: luna_maya.jpg
caption: Luna plotting to steal my holiday cookie. :cookie:
```
Sam: Luna incoming! :heart_eyes_cat: uploading now.
Priya: Taking photos tonight — will try to get Milo to wear the tiny santa hat. no promises :sweat_smile:
Carlos: I can only manage blurry headbutts but will submit. also can we add a 'bloopers' month? :joy:
Jen: Count me in. I'll attach a short holiday quote for the caption.
CalendarBot: Submission recorded for Sam (file: luna_maya.jpg) — thanks! :white_check_mark:
Sam: woo! thx bot :raised_hands:
Priya: Milo refused the hat but gave a dramatic side-eye. caption idea: 'I tolerate your traditions.' :smirk:
Carlos: also voting mechanics? how do we pick winners?
Maya: We'll do a staff-only anonymous poll next week in #random. People vote for favorites; Ops picks cover from top 5. Winners get a $25 local pet-shop gift card + calendar print.
Jen: deadline reminder? timezone?
Maya: Deadline = Friday 23:59 PT. I'll ping again on Thursday. If you're remote and shipping is hard we can email a high-res file instead.
Carlos: can we submit plants? my philodendron is my emotional support greenery :herb:
Maya: Ha — let's keep it to actual pets (furry, scaly, feathered, or fostered). Plants get honorary mentions in the bloopers page.
Sam: posted pic in thread. caption: 'Luna: chief nap officer.' :zzz:
Priya: uploaded — Milo didn't smile but his eyes say 'mild contempt'. :laughing:
Jen: uploaded quote + doggo photo. caption: 'All I want for Christmas is treats.' :dog:
CalendarBot: Reminder scheduled: 1767009000 -> 1767012199 (24h left)
Submission summary: 3 files so far.
Maya: If anyone needs help resizing or extracting from iPhone Live Photo DM me and I can help convert.
Carlos: thanks — might take you up on that.
Maya: Thanks all! This will be a cute office thing and good for showing up at the office kitchen during Q1. :calendar: :paw_prints:
